Spacecraft ThinSat-2
Spacecraft type ThinSat
Units or mass ThinSat 1T
Mass in kg 2.14 kg
Entity name Virginia Space
Institution Non-profit
Entity Academic / Education
Nation US
Partners NearSpace Launch (NSL), Twiggs Space Lab, Orbital ATK, NASA Wallops Flight Facility
Oneliner

ThinSat satellite platform for educational training.
Description

Low cost, short term program that will increase student engagement and interest in STEM fields. Short-term missions completed in a school year. Uses latest technology for satellites. Universal satellite design integrated with personalized payload. Scientific analysis of the atmosphere. Approximately 5 days of orbit life. No space debris after ThinSat deorbit.
